welcome.title: Welcome, Commander
welcome.body1: <0>Ascendants Warfront</0> is a lane-based tactical card battler. Deploy units, cast spells, and outmaneuver the enemy before your Nexus falls.
welcome.body2: This quick tour walks through every part of the board.

nexus.title: Your Nexus
nexus.body1: Your <0>Nexus</0> starts at 20 HP. If it reaches 0, you lose the match.
nexus.body2: Protect lanes — uncontested enemy units strike your Nexus every combat phase.

enemy.title: Enemy Command
enemy.body1: The enemy has their own <0>mana</0>, <1>Nexus HP</1>, and hidden <2>deck</2> (face-down cards on the left).
enemy.body2: Destroy their Nexus to win and earn a +6 gold bonus.

lanes.title: Three Lanes
lanes.body1: The battlefield has <0>three lanes</0>. Each side can hold one unit per lane.
lanes.rule1: Both occupied → units trade damage (⚔ Attack vs HP).
lanes.rule2: Only your unit → you hit the enemy Nexus.
lanes.rule3: Only enemy unit → they hit your Nexus.

mana.title: Mana
mana.body1: Spend <0>mana</0> to play cards. You gain +1 max mana each round (cap 10).
mana.body2: Unused mana does not carry over — spend it before ending your turn.

hand.title: Your Hand & Deck
hand.body1: Cards in your <0>personal deck</0> appear here. Click a card, then click a lane to deploy or cast.
hand.rule2: Spells → target a lane (or auto-cast for nexus heals).
hand.rule3: Click your unit, then another lane to move or swap.

strike.title: End Your Turn — STRIKE
strike.body1: When you are done deploying, moving, and casting, press <0>STRIKE</0> to end your turn.
strike.body2: The enemy plays next, then combat resolves automatically.

gold.title: Gold Economy
gold.body1: After each round you earn <0>gold</0> based on combat (win / tie / lose) plus base income.
gold.body2: Spend gold in the Main Deck shop to grow your army.

shop.title: Main Deck Shop
shop.body1: Buy face-down cards from the shared <0>Main Deck</0> into your personal deck (max {{maxDeck}} cards).
shop.rule2: Refresh restocks all four shop slots (limited uses).
shop.rule3: Bought slots stay empty until you refresh.

reference.title: Quick Reference
reference.body1: This panel summarizes deck limits and round gold payouts. Reopen the tour anytime with the <0>Guide</0> button in the top-right.

ready.title: You're Ready
ready.body1: <0>Core loop:</0> Deploy → STRIKE → Combat → Earn gold → Shop → Repeat.
ready.body2: Good luck, Commander. May your lanes hold.
